events.title: Promoting Menstrual Hygiene and Empowering Girls at Saint Paul School
events.excerpt: On 25th May 2026, HIDAH Humanitarian Foundation had the privilege of visiting Saint Paul School, Ashaley Botwe, to hold a personal hygiene education session and distribute sanitary pads to the female students.

events.title: Bringing Healthcare Closer to the Community: A Free Health Screening Initiative
events.excerpt: On 31st July 2026, the HIDAH Humanitarian Foundation organized a Free Health Screening Programme providing a range of essential healthcare services aimed at improving access to quality medical care, promoting preventive health, and supporting well-being across the local community.

events.title: Empowering the Next Generation Through Skills, Leadership & AI Training
events.excerpt: From 5th – 6th September 2026, HIDAH Humanitarian Foundation hosted an inspiring 2-Day Skills Development, Leadership & AI Training. The program was filled with learning, growth, confidence, creativity, connection, and empowerment.
